title: Before you pay for a gym, try these 4 in your hallway
caption: Home workout before you join a gym: four moves in your hallway, three rounds, about ten minutes. Reverse Lunge, Wall Sit, Standing Hip Hinge and Knee Plank, every day for two weeks. Save this before you sign up for anything.

overlays.text: Before you pay for a gym, try this in your hallway.

scenes.footer: Squat. One step of hallway is all it takes.

overlays.text: Reverse Lunge. 6 each side. Step one foot back, lower the knee, stand back up.

scenes.footer: Squat. Any bare stretch of wall.

overlays.text: Wall Sit. 30 seconds. Back flat on the hallway wall, knees bent, hold.

scenes.footer: Hinge. Room to bend forward is all it needs.

overlays.text: Standing Hip Hinge. 10 reps. Push your hips back, flat back, stand tall again.

scenes.footer: Core. The hallway rug is enough.

overlays.text: Knee Plank. 25 seconds. Forearms down, knees down, body in one straight line.

scenes.footer: Not before. Until then, you are building it in your hallway.

overlays.text: Do three rounds every day. When all four feel easy for two weeks, a gym makes sense.

scenes.footer: Save this before you sign up for anything.

overlays.text: Which of the four felt hardest?
